sources.cite: Kofinas, A. K., et al. (2025). The impact of generative AI on academic integrity of authentic assessments within a higher education context. British Journal of Educational Technology, 56.

sources.finding: Argues authentic-assessment design alone is not sufficient protection against GenAI; competency claims must rest on critical-thinking/process evidence rather than polished product, reinforcing the section's warrant-and-outcome standard.
